headline: Servotech Renewable Power discloses Q2 financial results for fiscal year 2027
summary: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited has submitted its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. headline: Servotech Renewable Power System appoints Kamal Sharma as internal auditor
hook: New internal auditor at Servotech Renewable
summary: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Kamal Sharma as the internal auditor of the company. The appointment is effective from November 03, 2026. This is a routine internal governance filing submitted to the stock exchange. Indian retail investors generally track such changes as a standard procedural update.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance update with no direct financial impact.
